name: trellis
description: Local kanban and knowledge base for AI agents: board state at session start, cards with leases, and a linked markdown knowledge base.

interface.shortDescription: Local kanban and knowledge for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Trellis gives AI coding agents a local kanban board and linked markdown knowledge base. Use it to claim work safely, record progress, preserve discoveries, and recover context across sessions.
defaultPrompt: Show my Trellis work and blockers.
Claim the next available Trellis card.
Save this session's verified findings in Trellis.
